The user requested the Notifications section be added *below* the buttons within the context of the settings. It appears as a disconnected second component.
defects.location: Entire lower half of the design

defects.description: Excessive vertical gap between the Account Settings card and the Notifications card makes them look like unrelated components rather than a single settings view.
defects.location: Space between the two dark cards

defects.description: The toggle switches in the Notifications section lack labels on the left side (only text is visible) and look slightly generic compared to the polished inputs above.

missing_elements: Integrated layout for the Notifications section (it should likely be inside the main card or visually grouped with it)
regressions: The overall vertical height and positioning of the original 'Account Settings' card has shifted up/left.
The internal spacing/padding of the top card seems to have tightened slightly.
top_fixes: Merge the 'Notifications' section into the main 'Account Settings' card container, placing it below the buttons separated by a divider.
If keeping them separate, significantly reduce the vertical gap between the two cards and align their left edges perfectly.
Ensure the toggles have clear label alignment matching the input fields above.

manifest.prompt: Add a 'Notifications' section below with two toggle rows - 'Email updates' and 'Product news' - both shown switched on.
